77920.subject: 📐 Claude breaks math history
77920.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** An Anthropic mathematician and Claude cracked a math question that stumped everyone since 1948. Sam Altman says the industry made AI sound terrifying. Anthropic's forbidden model got its first public job, and businesses are refusing to pay up for the best model ever built.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Claude:** What 78-year-old mystery did it just crack?

* **Altman:** Why is he mocking his own industry's pitch?

* **Anthropic:** What did it finally let its forbidden model do?

* **Fable 5:** Why won't businesses pay for the best model ever?


----------



----------
## Claude broke a math mystery from 1948

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/46c9bc26-8394-4176-967b-510b91876776/Aug_24_-_1.jpg?t=1787562565)
Caption: 

Does the six-dimensional sphere admit a complex structure? Mathematicians have [fought over that question](https://x.com/__alpoge__/status/2091639597193368014) since 1948, and generations of them failed to settle it.

On Sunday, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge posted the answer.

**"Yup."**

He says the structure exists, he built it with Claude, and the result is a new geometric object he calls beautiful. Decades of papers had described what such a thing would look like while assuming it was a ghost.

There's no paper up yet, so this stays a first-party claim until other mathematicians grind through the proof.




----------









----------
## Nvidia cost less than a coffee ten years ago

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e26a5a49-9574-4bc5-881d-9318cfb80afd/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_7__2026__11_00_32_AM.png?t=1786089655)
Follow image link: (https://utm.genai.works/r/kuzbv0q)
Caption: 

Ten years ago a share of Nvidia went for under $2, split-adjusted, and most people filed it away as a gaming company. Today it sits among the most valuable companies on Earth.

Nobody rings a bell at the start of those runs. The people who won were simply in before the crowd agreed it was obvious.

GenAI Works is at that stage now.

We reach 14 million people, work with 300+ AI brands and run go-to-market for Nvidia, yes that Nvidia, plus Oracle, Google, IBM and Notion. Revenue grew 2.5x last year, and $2.7 million is already committed.

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!

Yours faithfully
